Best Interior Design in Hauz Khas for Attractive & Practical Designs

Homes, offices and salons across Hauz Khas and South Delhi.

Beautiful and functional is the ideal combination when it comes to design. Interior design can enhance the functionality and aesthetics of any space, be it residential, commercial, professional, a workplace, or service-based, like a salon or spa.

At 9th Corner, when developing an interior, we emphasise the requirements, style, and preferences of the client. We provide the best interior designers in Hauz Khas, appealing design, practical and careful execution, and smart space utilisation, along with simple design planning.

Design That Starts With Your Needs

Everyone wants something different.

While some clients want minimalist and modern homes, others want luxury homes furnished with stylish finishes, while a business may want an office that helps them conduct their day-to-day activities better or an optimal showroom design for their clients.

Prior to initiating the design, we conduct a detailed study of the client's requirements.

We analyse the dimensions of the given space, intended use, storage requirements, required furniture, lighting, the client's budget, and preferred style.

This informs us of how we should approach the design for the client rather than following a standard design for all our projects.

A Simple Interior Design Process

While the process of interior design may seem lengthy, it is quite simple.

We survey the space and discuss the project. We design the layout and place the required furniture, storage, lights, colours, and other elements.

For an added practical edge, we present 3D designs to the client before actual work begins.

This makes it easier to visualise the design and helps one make changes at the right moments.

The focus is on maintaining clarity from the first concept to the final presentation.

Residential Interior Design in Hauz Khas

A home should be a reflection of comfort and be personal.

We plan interior spaces to incorporate the family's lifestyle. This can entail planning the living spaces, bedrooms, kitchens, dining areas, wardrobes, storage, and other design solutions to suit daily requirements.

Hauz Khas has distinct types of homes and properties, which means every project necessitates a unique design approach.

Smaller homes may require more efficient, space-saving storage. Larger homes may have space for more custom furniture and can have more flexible finishes.

The intention is to keep the design refined and beautiful while still maintaining usability.

Office Interior Design

An office design should help optimise the work process for employees.

Design can incorporate workstations and cabins, meeting rooms, a reception area, storage, and a variety of common areas.

For the design and placement of furniture, the layout should support free movement around the space.

The design can incorporate lighting, colours, and wall surfaces in combination with the company’s work culture.

Whether it is a small office or a large workplace, the design should maintain a balance of work, comfort, and a professional look.

Salon Interior Design in Hauz Khas

A design should optimise the functional requirements of a salon while also having a smooth aesthetic.

Customers must feel comfortable remaining in the space, while the staff must have enough room to provide the services.

As the best salon interior designer in Hauz Khas, 9th Corner takes care of each detail in designing a salon, from the reception area and styling stations to the waiting and wash spaces, as well as the position of the mirrors, storage, and lighting.

Functional design is as important as the aesthetics of a space. Lighting in a salon has to ensure that there is adequate light for the daily work of the staff while also creating a positive atmosphere for clients.

All the elements of a space, such as colours, furniture, and walls, can be brought together with the brand to create a cohesive visual design.

A well-designed salon helps improve the experience of clients and makes the daily work of the staff easier.

Effective Space Design

Good design is not just about decoration.

It is about utilising all areas of a space efficiently.

Using smart design techniques, a small room can be made to feel more spacious, while a large room can be made more comfortable by dividing it into various clear, functional areas.

We consider the purpose of the space, the movement of the occupants, furniture and storage placement, and the daily use of the space before selecting decorative finishes.

This creates an appealing design while maintaining high functionality.

Use of Colours and Materials

Colours and materials can completely change the perceived mood of a space.

Light-coloured finishes reflect light and visually expand a space, unlike dark colours. Warm materials can create a feeling of comfort. The mood and focus of the space can be intentionally controlled by the placement of lighting.

These various unified elements of design can be planned to support and create a cohesive space.

Why Should You Hire Our Firm for Your Project?

When it comes to choosing the right design team, you want to hire professionals who can relieve a lot of stress when it comes to the design and construction of your project.

The right design team can help you improve the design of your space through:

  • Optimal space usage
  • Furniture and storage placement
  • Lighting design
  • Colour selection
  • Material selection
  • Planning 3D designs of your project
  • Taking care of all the design, planning, and execution so that things go smoothly
  • Designing based on your needs

The design can be as complex or simple as you want, but good design planning can minimise the amount of stress you feel when a design is being created and the project is underway.

Design for Different Types of Spaces

Design is definitely not one-size-fits-all. Each space is and should be designed for a specific purpose.

A family home may need a design that incorporates storage and comfort. A luxury home may need a design with luxury finishes. An office may need a design that incorporates a workspace, practicality, and the flow of staff. A salon may need customer comfort and staff flow.

These are the concerns we address with each of our projects.

The design is what you get, but what is most important is the client experience and satisfaction with the end result.

Why 9th Corner?

A good design team should have more than an understanding of colours and furnishings. A good design team should incorporate the space, understand what the client wants, and be able to design with a focus on the details.

At 9th Corner, we aim to blend good design with practical application. This is from the first discussion to the last.

For our clients looking for the top interior design firm in Hauz Khas, we create spaces specifically suited to your needs, your space, and your lifestyle.

Conclusion

The best interior designers can improve the use and comfort of any space. Homes, offices, salons, restaurants, stores, and other spaces all benefit from the right design.

For the best interior designers in Hauz Khas, 9th Corner focuses on its clients and works to design around their needs.
